typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileExtn as string (),
	FileNameList as string (),
	FilePattern as string (),
	ParentPackageExecutionID as integer (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		StorefrontProductID as string,
		SKU as string,
		ProductName as string,
		DistributorSource as string,
		CreatedOn as string,
		UpdatedOn as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ReadfromProductFile	source(output(
		StorefrontVariantID as string,
		StorefrontProductID as string,
		VariantSKU as string,
		VariantName as string,
		Cost as string,
		ListPrice as string,
		SalePrice as string,
		IsTaxable as string,
		IsShipSeparately as string,
		IsDefaultVariant as string,
		DistributorSource as string,
		CreatedOn as string,
		UpdatedOn as string,
		Dimensions as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ReadfromProductVarntFile
ReadfromProductFile derive(ProductName = trim(ProductName),
		DistributorSource = trim(DistributorSource),
		UpdatedOn = trim(UpdatedOn),
		CreatedOn = trim(CreatedOn),
		SKU = trim(SKU),
		StorefrontProductID = trim(StorefrontProductID)) ~> TrimProductColumns
ReadfromProductVarntFile derive(VariantSKU = trim(VariantSKU),
		StorefrontVariantID = trim(StorefrontVariantID),
		VariantName = trim(VariantName),
		Dimensions = trim(Dimensions),
		IsShipSeparately = trim(IsShipSeparately),
		ListPrice = trim(ListPrice),
		StorefrontProductID = trim(StorefrontProductID),
		Cost = trim(Cost),
		IsDefaultVariant = trim(IsDefaultVariant),
		DistributorSource = trim(DistributorSource),
		UpdatedOn = trim(UpdatedOn),
		SalePrice = trim(SalePrice),
		CreatedOn = trim(CreatedOn),
		IsTaxable = trim(IsTaxable)) ~> TrimProductVariantColumns
TrimProductColumns sort(asc(StorefrontProductID, false)) ~> SortProductId
TrimProductVariantColumns sort(asc(StorefrontProductID, false)) ~> SortProductIdinProdVrnt
SortProductIdinProdVrnt,SortProductId join(TrimProductVariantColumns@StorefrontProductID == TrimProductColumns@StorefrontProductID,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeProductandVariant
MergeProductandVariant select(mapColumn(
		StorefrontVariantID = StorefrontVariantID,
		StorefrontProductID = TrimProductColumns@StorefrontProductID,
		VariantSKU = VariantSKU,
		VariantName = VariantName,
		Cost = Cost,
		ListPrice = ListPrice,
		SalePrice = SalePrice,
		Dimensions = Dimensions,
		IsTaxable = IsTaxable,
		IsShipSeparately = IsShipSeparately,
		IsDefaultVariant = IsDefaultVariant,
		DistributorSource = TrimProductColumns@DistributorSource,
		CreatedOn = TrimProductColumns@CreatedOn,
		UpdatedOn = TrimProductColumns@UpdatedOn,
		ProductSKU = ProductSKU,
		ProductName = ProductName,
		ProductDistributorSource = ProductDistributorSource,
		ProductCreatedOn = ProductCreatedOn,
		ProductUpdatedOn = ProductUpdatedOn
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeProductandVariantSelect
MergeProductandVariantSelect derive(StorefrontVariantID = StorefrontVariantID,
		StorefrontProductID = StorefrontProductID,
		VariantSKU = VariantSKU,
		VariantName = VariantName,
		Cost = Cost,
		ListPrice = ListPrice,
		SalePrice = SalePrice,
		Dimensions = Dimensions,
		IsTaxable = IsTaxable,
		IsShipSeparately = IsShipSeparately,
		IsDefaultVariant = IsDefaultVariant,
		DistributorSource = DistributorSource,
		CreatedOn = CreatedOn,
		UpdatedOn = UpdatedOn,
		ProductSKU = ProductSKU,
		ProductName = ProductName,
		ProductDistributorSource = ProductDistributorSource,
		ProductCreatedOn = ProductCreatedOn,
		ProductUpdatedOn = ProductUpdatedOn) ~> MergeProductandVariantREFORMAT1
MergeProductandVariantREFORMAT1 derive(StorefrontVariantID = StorefrontVariantID) ~> PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError
PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError derive(StorefrontVariantID = StorefrontVariantID) ~> PlaceHolderGetETLChecksum
PlaceHolderGetETLChecksum derive(ETLCreateDate = $startTime,
		ETLExecutionID = $PackageExecutionID) ~> DeriveETLColumns
DeriveETLColumns sink(input(
		VariantSKU as string,
		ProductSKU as string,
		ETLCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		StorefrontVariantID as string,
		ProductName as string,
		ETLChecksum as string,
		VariantName as string,
		Dimensions as string,
		ProductDistributorSource as string,
		IsShipSeparately as string,
		ListPrice as string,
		StorefrontProductID as string,
		Cost as string,
		IsDefaultVariant as string,
		ProductCreatedOn as string,
		DistributorSource as string,
		ETLExecutionID as long,
		UpdatedOn as string,
		SalePrice as string,
		CreatedOn as string,
		ProductUpdatedOn as string,
		IsTaxable as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		VariantSKU,
		ProductSKU,
		ETLCreateDate,
		StorefrontVariantID,
		ProductName,
		ETLChecksum,
		VariantName,
		Dimensions,
		ProductDistributorSource,
		IsShipSeparately,
		ListPrice,
		StorefrontProductID,
		Cost,
		IsDefaultVariant,
		ProductCreatedOn,
		DistributorSource,
		ETLExecutionID,
		UpdatedOn,
		SalePrice,
		CreatedOn,
		ProductUpdatedOn,
		IsTaxable)) ~> WritetoStgEProduct
